"""The ``default`` schedule."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import final

from typing_extensions import override
from xtr_scheduler import Schedule, ScheduleProviderInterface
from xtr_scheduler.decorator import as_schedule

__all__ = ["ReportSchedule"]


@final
@as_schedule("default")
class ReportSchedule(ScheduleProviderInterface):
    """The ``default`` schedule; describe what it sends here."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Build the schedule."""
        # Add what it sends, such as RecurringMessage.every("1 hour", PlaceOrder()).
        self._schedule = Schedule()

    @override
    def get_schedule(self) -> Schedule:
        """Return the schedule built once, with the provider."""
        return self._schedule
